text:
Ava (finance): Heads-up — I just spotted 2 duplicate vendor credit memos for ACME Data created by the nightly billing-export backfill. Amounts look identical: $2,400 each. Vendor balance is off.
billing-bot: export-backfill-job completed: job_id=bf-2026-03-23-03, processed=12k records, warnings=3
Marco (eng-platform): ugh. did the backfill reprocess webhooks or run with idempotency disabled?
Priya (billing-sre): Checking logs now. Looks like the backfill shipped an empty idempotency_key for vendor_credit create in 03:04 window. Patch incoming.
Samir (finance-ops): FYI these credits have been posted to AR/AP but not applied to invoices yet. We should hold auto-pay cycle until fixed.
Leah (accounting): Can you confirm vendor ledger delta? ACME shows +$4,800 credit; we need reversal before month close.
Priya (billing-sre): Query to find dupes:
```
SELECT id, vendor_id, amount, created_at, source_job
FROM vendor_credits
WHERE vendor_id = 'vendor_acme'
AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-23 03:00' AND '2026-03-23 03:10'
ORDER BY created_at;
```

I'll run and share results in 5.
billing-bot: alert: idempotency_error_count=27 in bf-2026-03-23-03
Marco (eng-platform): Root cause: backfill job used the "create" endpoint instead of "upsert" when idempotency_key is null. Fix: ensure idempotency key generation before enqueue. I'll PR a hotfix.
Samir (finance-ops): Proposed immediate remediation:
- pause auto-pay
- mark duplicate credits as 'void' and create reversing journal
- notify ACME
Need Jon's approval for manual JE up to $5k.
Jon (CFO): Approve manual JE up to $5k. Proceed.
Ava (finance): Thanks. Priya/Marco — can you estimate time to run void+reversal? Need completion before EOD close.
Priya (billing-sre): Can do void + reversal in ~40m, then run a validation pass. I'll push a small script to mark duplicates and emit audit log.
Marco (eng-platform): Hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/ops/pull/12345. Will deploy once tests pass (~15m).
Leah (accounting): Once reversed, I'll reconcile and confirm with ACME. Please tag me when done.
Samir (finance-ops): Noted. Will hold auto-pay flag and send vendor note draft.
Ava (finance): Vendor note looks fine. Ping when done. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: remediation_run: started job_id=rem-2141594367-1
Priya (billing-sre): remediation complete. Voided duplicate ids vc-98765 & vc-98766, created reversal JE je-4521. Audit: /logs/2141594367/rem-1
Leah (accounting): Confirmed adjustments. ACME balance restored. Closing.
Ava (finance): Great work team, postmortem pls. :raised_hands:
